chunks: And Abān narrated from Fuḍayl ibn Yasār, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
If a woman performs Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ and completes more than half of it, then she menstruates, she may depart if she wishes.

key_terms.أَكْثَرَ مِنَ النِّصْفِ: more than half, indicating the threshold mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman addressed in the legal ruling
key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf specifically required in relation to women after hajj rites

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman menstruates after completing more than half of Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who begins menstruating during Ṭawāf al-Nisāʾ. If she has completed more than half of the tawaf, she is permitted to depart if she wishes.
